# Zedu — Full Product Context

> Zedu is an AI-powered education platform built for bootcamps, schools, universities, and other learning communities. This document is the extended version of llms-full context for AI assistants: full feature breakdowns, pricing tier comparisons, and integration specifications.

Zedu is a per-organization workspace that brings communication, live classes, files, and AI assistance into a single product. It is designed for teams that currently run cohorts across separate chat, video, and file tools.

## Platform overview

- Workspace model: each organization gets its own workspace with channels, members, direct messages, and files.
- Audience: bootcamps, schools, universities, training teams, and cohort-based learning communities.
- Access: web app plus native iOS and Android apps (see https://zedu.chat/download).
- Sign-in: email plus Google and Apple sign-in options.

## Core modules

### Structured channels
- Channels for cohorts, classes, topics, and teams, with threads to keep discussions in context.
- Direct messages and group DMs for one-to-one and small-group communication.
- Channel details, membership management, and moderation tools for admins and teachers.
- Product page: https://zedu.chat/products/channels

### Buzz video calls
- Instant voice and video conversations for quick check-ins.
- Live classes and meetings for cohorts, with recording support.
- Product page: https://zedu.chat/products/buzz

### File management
- Upload files into the workspace, organize them in folders, and share them into channels.
- Pin/favourite important files, search and filter by name, type, uploader, and date.
- Preview common document and media types in the browser.
- Product page: https://zedu.chat/products/file-management

### AI coworkers
- AI assistants that live in the workspace and help teachers and cohort managers with everyday tasks.
- Overview: https://zedu.chat

## Cohort workflows

1. Create a workspace for the organization and invite teachers/admins.
2. Create a channel per cohort or class and invite students (bulk invitations are supported).
3. Run live sessions with Buzz, keep discussion in channels and threads.
4. Share slides, recordings, and documents through file management.
5. Use AI coworkers for drafting, summarizing, and study support.

## Pricing

Prices are in Nigerian naira (₦) and billed monthly per workspace (not per student). US dollar equivalents are approximate. Annual billing for Pro is available on request via sales.

| Plan | Price | Cohorts | Members | Teachers/Admins | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter | Free | Up to 3 | Up to 100 in total | Up to 5 | No credit card required |
| Pro | ₦20,000 / month per workspace | Unlimited | Up to 500 students per cohort | Up to 50 | Adds live classes, AI study assistants, admin moderation |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom student limits per cohort | Custom | Unlimited | Custom billing and dedicated onboarding |

- Move from Starter to Pro when a workspace needs more than 3 cohorts, 100 members, or 5 teachers/admins.
- Enterprise is intended for universities and large bootcamps; see https://zedu.chat/contact-sales
- Full pricing page: https://zedu.chat/pricing

## Integrations and technical specifications

- Video and voice: powered by the Agora real-time communication SDK for Buzz calls.
- Push notifications: web push plus OneSignal for mobile/web notifications.
- Authentication: email/password with Google and Apple sign-in.
- Automation: outbound webhooks for events such as registration, login, page visits, success, and errors.
- Realtime transport: WebSocket-based live updates for messages and presence.
- Media: files and images are stored in cloud object storage and served over HTTPS.
